text: 🛡️ Dawn at Haven. By the fire hangs an old bark cuirass, split at the seam — somebody's grandfather wore this into the treeline and came back. The shape of it is clear: bark plates laced overlapping like shingles, vine
🛡️ The shield wall forms — strongest arms to The Eulogy, The Eulogy. The small teeth can wait their turn.
🛡️ David follows a woman, maybe 30s, with calloused knuckles in — The Eulogy still stands.
🛡️ Hassan follows Zoltan in — The Eulogy still stands.
🛡️ The shield wall forms — strongest arms to The Rerun, The Cancellation. The small teeth can wait their turn.
🛡️ Zoltan follows a woman, maybe 50s in — The Rerun still stands.
🛡️ Hassan follows a man, maybe 60s in — The Cancellation still stands.
🛡️ The shield wall forms — strongest arms to The Rerun. The small teeth can wait their turn.
🛡️ a man, maybe 20s follows a man, maybe 60s in — The Rerun still stands.
